pages.text: Matching full set: G spends 150 base energy to reforge a 50-point energy shield, with no cooldown or stacking. At full shield it shows a message and spends nothing. Shield Weaving talents can repair it using energy. Removing the set/death clears it.$(br2)Dominion grants a separate 1000-point guardian barrier; G does not repair it. It survives the domain ending, unequipping and logout until depleted. Recasting refreshes, never stacks. Barrier absorbs before energy shield; excess hits health. Golden-apple absorption remains separate.
